# Quorate

> A multi-agent code review council for local CLI and GitHub PR workflows.

Quorate convenes a council of AI code reviewers over a diff or plan, aggregates
their findings, and returns one verdict with concrete file-and-line evidence. It
runs the AI CLIs you already have on your machine and ships a GitHub Action.

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/quorate): `npm install -g quorate`

## Install

```bash
npm install -g quorate
quorate
```

Requires Node.js 22.22.0 or newer.

## Key concepts

- **Council**: Multiple AI reviewers (architect, security, QA, performance, maintainer roles)
- **Verdict**: Single PASS / WARN / FAIL outcome after deduplication
- **Degraded**: Honest label when only the heuristic provider ran — never a false green
- **Providers**: Local CLIs (`claude`, `codex`, `qwen`, `kimi`, …) plus a zero-setup heuristic
- **GitHub Action**: PR reviews; loads `.quorate.yml` from the base branch for safety

## CLI quick reference

```bash
quorate doctor                            # readiness checklist
quorate review --base main --head HEAD    # review current branch
quorate plan "migrate auth to passkeys"   # evaluate a plan
quorate init                              # write starter .quorate.yml
```
